balls.text: run-out looking for a run that wasn't there. Yorker, tailing in outside off. Chucks the bat at it. Cue-ended towards deep point. Makes a late decision to return for the second, after the fielder's already picked up the ball. And he isn't in the frame. Bairstow accidentally walks into the stumps but only one bail falls off. So the wickets are still in play with one bail on. He picks up the throw and breaks the stumps to end Punjab's innings
just short of long-off. Offbreak at a length on off stump, looks to drive, one hand comes off, but all's well for him in the end
Bairstow let's that through. A quick offbreak at length, from middle and off. Past the bat and the keeper doesn't stay down. That's drawn a big facepalm from the bowler

edged and taken behind! Kaul gets into the wickets as well. An offcutter, full and wide outside off. Shuffles and swings for the leg side. A thick edge floats up to Bairstow's right and he takes it easily
slower ball at a length outside off, opens the face and runs it to third man
short of a length just outside off, backs away and cuts to sweeper
short of a length and a cutter just outside off, gets behind that and steers to third man
past the edge. Slower ball at a length outside off, looks to drive away from the body
slower ball at a length on leg stump, flicked to short fine's left

picks out deep midwicket! Slower ball at a length outside off, picks it up for the slog but there's no pace to work with. It floats out easily for the fielder there and Punjab lose out on two overs of Shahrukh, who was looking good
yorker wide outside off, thick outside edge to third man
length at off stump, defended into the covers off the front foot
short of a length outside off, looks to cut, gets a thick edge. The fielder at third is fine and puts in a slide, but that sneaks through
low full toss outside off, looks to pump that over mid-off but gets it off the toe-end. Drops safely to the left of that fielder
good length and just outside off, dropped in front of backward point to steal a run
short of a length at off stump, punched to midwicket off the back foot
short of a length cutter outside off, steered to sweeper's left with a cut
full toss across off stump, looks to stab at it and is beaten
taken at extra cover! Warner flies to his right and completes the catch. Short of a length slower ball outside off, looks to force that punch off the back foot and ends up slicing it
short of a length outside off, pulled to deep midwicket
short of a length offcutter outside off, steered straight to short third
offcutter, short of a length and wide outside off. Can't beat backward point with the cut
short of a length just outside off, backs away and cuts to sweeper
good length, slider at middle stump. Punched back to the bowler
googly at off stump, gets forward and defends off the inside half with one hand off the bat
full outside off, looks to drive through cover, thick inside edge to deep midwicket
googly, full and outside off. Inside edge to short fine's left as he looks to drive
rips it past. Whew. And quick work from Bairstow to take the bails off. Batsman's in though, he was beaten on the forward block
rolls past leg stump as he defends this onto his body. A slower ball. Shahrukh calls for the run and is safely in as Bairstow runs down and kicks it onto the stumps
looks to ramp and loses his shape. Length outside off, got down and adjusted to steer this to short third. A direct hit would have had Allen
belts it over deep midwicket! Slower ball at a length outside off, spinning into his arc. He steps into line and slogs cleanly
length at off stump, defended to point off the back foot. The siren goes off for no-ball
good length at off stump, blocked on the front foot
short of a length just outside off, beaten on the cut
good length and just outside off, cut to backward point
short of a length turner from middle stump, mistimed pull back to the bowler
length ball down leg side, beaten on the sweep
good length on middle stump, pushed into the off side with soft hands

stumped this time! Beaten in flight, too far down the pitch to react. Middle stump ball, he was looking to go over cover, he was too far away from it and it spun past him. Lots of time for Bairstow to gather and complete the dismissal
full outside off, steps out and yorks himself. It rolls down to long-on off the inside half
crunched over deep square! Full and into leg stump, gets down on one knee and nails this slog sweep
turns a long way from leg stump. He has to adjust and punch this into the covers

past everyone again! Rashid is a menace on this surface. This is a googly, good length outside off. He looks to drive, nowhere close to the ball and there is a massive gap for the ball to rip through. Bairstow is can't get anything on it
short of a length at middle stump, pulled firmly to deep square's left, stopped with a slide

is that a stumping chance? Yeah, half a chance anyway. Legbreak delivered with a googly release, the batsman's looked to flick from off stump thinking that's a googly. It rips past him and Bairstow doesn't seem to have picked it either. Catches him unaware and deflects to short third off his body
top edge lands safely to backward point's right. Whew, that shot up from the pitch! Short of  a length legbreak that he was looking to pull
googly, at a length and wide outside. Can't get the drive away, rolls back to the bowler off the inside half
full outside off, gets to the pitch and flicks to short fine
loopy length ball again, wide outside off. Throws the hands at it with a cover drive. Thick edge trickles to short third's left
loopy length ball at middle stump, steps out and doesn't make the pitch of it. Stabs it back to the bowler
tossed up at leg stump, leans in and flicks into the leg side

that looks plumb. He's reviewed it after a chat with Moises, but this looks very very out. It's a length ball, pushed through quick, and he's caught on the back foot trying to shovel it fine. It's an arm ball. He's struck in front of leg stump. It needs to be sliding down leg for him to survive...it is umpire's call. That is out. A bit of a fade there for Hooda, He was happy to sweep and be on the front foot so far, completely misjudges this one
good length at middle stump, punched down the pitch and Sharma misfields this. Deflected to long-on
good length and dipping at middle stump, steps out and goes with the turn, inside-out to long-off's left
googly, lobbed up slow and turning in from outside off. Cops it on the pad as he looks to flick
full outside off, gets very low again and sweeps to square leg
oh nicely played. Length ball outside off, gets really low and connects with the reverse sweep on this legbreak. Fine of backward point
short of a length legbreak outside off, walks across and swats it to deep backward square
googly at a length on off, shuffles and paddles it to short fine
full at off stump, hurriedly drives to long-off with the turn
full and drifted in at leg stump, steps out and drives to long-off
length at middle stump, steps out and punches to long-on
full at leg stump, steps out and stabs this down to long-on
short of a length at middle stump, pushed to deep midwicket off the back foot with soft hands
full and dipping into the crease, he can't get this drive past the bowler
full and floated in at middle stump, leans in and flicks to deep midwicket
another lbw appeal but once again he's walked into the off side for the sweep and is struck outside
lbw appeal as he looks to sweep, but he was well outside off when he was struck

he's struck right in front of middle and it's been given! He won't review it. It was a legbreak and the fact he's struck in front of middle would suggest it's pitched in line. He got forward to defend, not sure which way it was turning. Bat and pad close together but he is beaten and he is gone
legbreak ripping in sharply from middle and leg, catches him on the pad
legbreak at a length, wide outside off, swept along the floor to deep square's left
googly, short of a length and wide outside off, punched to long-off
slower ball at a length outside off, gets forward to defend and gets an inside edge down to fine leg
steps out and carves to sweeper's left. Offcutter at a length outside off, jumps out and wants to go inside-out over extra cover. Ends up slicing

just clears fine leg running to his left. Short ball at leg stump, shapes to pull and makes no effort to keep it down. Kaul runs in a little and to his left and then has to track back and jump. He can't get a hand on it. It bounces just inside
length ball jumps up as he looks to defend into the off side

Pooran is in at 4 for the first time this season. And he might be run out without facing a ball! Short of a length offcutter, stabbed to Warner's right at extra cover. He takes off. Pooran seems like he doesn't want it - but we'll have to see the replay again. Because there's no other explanation for him being miles out as Warner hits the stumps with a once-bounce throw. The season hasn't gotten any better for Pooran. Can't say that the run wasn't there

Rashid Khan takes one at midwicket and that will be sent upstairs. It was dipping on him again, this time slowly and in front of him. He thinks it's out, but there wasn't a big celebration. The umpires have referred it and there is pretty straightforward evidence that he had his hands under that. Redeems himself, picks up the same batter. This was another slower ball, short of a length and across off stump. Looked to force a pull over midwicket but that just didn't come on. The pull floated slowly out to Rashid, who lunged forward
offcutter, short of a length at off stump. Opens the face and drops this to backward point's right
full and at leg stump, regular paced delivery. Stands tall and tickles that past short fine with the angle
short of a length offcutter outside off, punched towards mid-on off the back foot
offcutter at a length on middle stump, flicked to deep square
short of a length and tight in the corridor, pushed down the pitch off the back foot
legcutter at a length on off stump, blocked on the front foot
short of a length at middle stump, defended off the back foot
short of a length at off stump, dropped into the covers and is sent back by Gayle
length and regular paced, just outside off and the first real drive on the up this match. Past extra cover but long-off cleans up to his left
thick edge runs fine of short third. Legcutter, back of a length at off stump. Really sticks. Mayank has thrown everything at this with a back foot punch
full and at the stumps, punched off the front foot to short extra
full and just outside off, driven along the ground to mid-off
steps out and hammers it past mid-on! Short of a length cutter outside off, steps out and he still has to wait. Comes on slowly but flies off the middle of the bat
offcutter at a length on off stump, punched on the up into the covers
good length and just outside off, punched on the up to sweeper's right
offcutter at a length on off stump, opens the face and pushes it out to sweeper cover
short of a length, just outside off. Punched on the up to sweeper cover
good length and just outside off, defended into the covers off the front foot
slower ball at a length on off stump, defended on the front foot
short of a length slower ball at off stump, punched to sweeper's left off the back foot
good length and tight at off stump, watchfully defended into the leg side off the inside edge
cuts past the outside edge and dies on the keeper. Length ball starting at middle and getting him to twirl the bat as it passes

taken at short midwicket. Short of a length delivery outside off, walks down at it and looks to launch that over midwicket. But he's had to really drag that, it stuck in the pitch. No pace on the shot and it's a simple grab for Jadhav to his left
slower ball, short of a length just outside off. Cut straight to backward point who fumbles and allows a run
slower ball at a length just outside off, opens the face and runs this to backward point off the front foot
slower ball at a length just outside off, punched to sweeper's right off the back foot
good length on leg stump, jabbed into the leg side with soft hands
slashed to deep backward point's right. Short and wide and across him. Reaches out and goes aerially to get it slightly in front of the fielder in the deep
good length and wide outside off, chopped on the up to cover
short of a length just outside off, punched on the up to sweeper cover
good length and just outside off, punched back at the bowler who can't field cleanly in the follow through
short of a length and sliding on low at middle stump, punched to mid-on's right
full at leg stump, leans in and pats to midwicket
short and just outside off, chops to sweeper's left
length and just outside off, shuffles and defends into the off side

dropped at deep midwicket! Rashid has put in a slide to his left and put it down after getting two hands on it. Dropped short at off stump, pulled flat and aerially to his left. He does superbly to judge this and put in the slide, because that was dipping quickly. But he can't hold on as he moves along the turf
full and just outside off, looks to drill through the covers but ends up jamming that into the pitch
short of a length and turning away from middle stump, squared up as he defends towards short third
full and slow, up at off stump. Yorker by the time he looks to drive. Chops it into his pads
good length and sliding on at off stump. Searches for some room and stays deep to try and play the late cut. Into the covers with a straight bat
good length and slanted into leg stump, flicks with the angle to short fine
slower ball, short and wide outside off. Left alone and that will be enough for the win
slower ball at a length outside off, cut to sweeper cover
dropped at mid-off. Full slower one at off stump, driven at chest height to Hooda's right. He stretches and is in line, gets two hands out. Catches it on the forearm of his right hand
clubbed over midwicket. Length ball at middle stump, walks down at it and swings across the line. Gets it off the middle and that puts the required runs in single digits now
slower ball, short of a length and just outside off. Slides under his attempted pull
short of a length and ripping into the thigh as he looks to play the glance
length outside off, deep in the crease and swipes this firmly to wide long-on
short at middle stump, pulled to long-on's right
run-out chance missed. Length ball at middle, flicked to midwicket's right. Takes off for a run and says no. KW is halfway down and stuck, but the fielder doesn't gather cleanly
short of a length and rising past the cut as he backs deep into the crease
first boundary in nearly seven overs. Brings up fifty for Bairstow. Hood drops it short, and it is flat, at middle stump. He gets deep in the crease and pulls between deep square and deep midwicket
tossed up outside off, leans in for the drive but yorks himself, that ends up pitch side on the leg side
googly, full and just outside off. Gets forward and whips to deep midwicket
short and wide outside off, mistimed cut to extra cover's left
short of a length googly at leg stump, punched down to long-on
short and turning away wide outside off, pulled to long-on
full toss at off stump, driven to long-off
slower short ball at off stump, waits on that and wants to stab that over short third. But there just isn't enough pace, it's 97kph. It ends up at sweeper cover
slower ball at a length on leg stump, lines up a pull shot but gets an inside edge onto pad that drops into the pitch

touch chance dropped at extra cover. Slower ball, short of a length outside off. Steps out and hammers this with a flat-bat. Henriques sticks out his right hand and cops that on the forehand, had to be aerial for that
slower ball at a length on middle stump, shoveled to deep midwicket
slower ball, short of a length and sliding on. No grip on that. Looks to cut and sounds like he gets an under-edge but that has rolled to Rahul anyway
short of a length and just outside off, opens the face and runs this to backward point. They sneak a risky single
short of a length outside off, punched to extra cover's left
full outside off, gets low and paddles to long leg's right
short and wide outside off, cut straight to extra cover
length at middle stump, deep in the crease to punch to long-on
length on off stump, blocked on the front foot
short and turning away outside off, cut to sweeper cover
short of a length at leg stump, punched to midwicket off the back foot
short and down leg side, pulled to deep square's right
length at leg stump, flicked to midwicket's right
dropped short at a middle stump line, pulled firmly to deep square
short of a length and turning into the body, waits on it and turns it into the leg side this time
short of a length and turning in to cramp him as he shapes to cut, gets it straight to extra cover
short of a length jut outside off, punched to extra cover's left
length at the stumps, driven to long-off
length and dipping at middle stump, Bairstow's feet rooted and he's forced to defend as he loses balance with the ball turning away
short of a length and sliding on outside off, waits on it and gets his late cut past slip. Lovely timing and touch play, but Mayank chases from backward point and stops it with a slide to save one
short and turning away outside off, cut to extra cover
short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper cover
full toss outside off, driven to long-off's left and they come back for a second against SRK's throw
nearly plays on. Short of a length and turning away outside off, looks to cut, away from the body. Inside edge past leg stump
short and turning away outside off, drags it down to long-on with a punch
full at middle stump, driven to long-on
googly, short of a length at off stump. Turned into midwicket with soft hands
full at off stump, to the pitch and driven to long-on
appeal for lbw turned down as he gets forward and misses on the defence. Arm ball going down, surely. But that is a wicker maiden
short of a length outside off, cut to backward point
short and just outside off, cut to backward point on the bounce
length at off stump, blocked on the front foot
short of a length and sliding on at middle stump. Exposes the stumps for the punch, gets it to extra cover

taken at deep midwicket! Short ball outside off, spins into him. He's looking to take six off that, an aerial pull. It comes off the low part of the bat and hangs nicely for Agarwal running to his right. Holds on and is fired up after doing so
short and rising steeply outside off, thick edge on the attempted cut. Well short of Gayle at short third
length outside off, defended with the turn towards point
full at off stump, blocked on the front foot

crunches that over deep extra! Lovely shot. It's turning for Hooda, but he's not a specialist spinner and Warner is able to predict where this will land - full and just outside off. Jumps out, gets leg side to create room, and whips firmly and quickly at that
short of a length outside off, shuffles for a mistimed pull to deep square's left
full and into leg stump, leans in and jabs to deep midwicket
full at leg stump, flicked to long-on's left
length at leg stump, steps out and flicks to deep square's left
legbreak and ripping into the pads as he looks to glance this fine
googly at a length on middle stump, reverse sweep straight to short third
short of a length legbreak outside off, deep in the crease to whip that into the leg side
full toss at off stump, subdued swipe to deep midwicket's left
length at middle stump, defended on the front foot
length outside off, pushed back to the bowler
beats the outside edge. Whew, dream ball. Seam up, lands at an off stump line, draws him forward and turns it past him
short of a length outside off, slapped on the bounce to extra cover
full at off stump, pushed back to the bowler off the front foot
short of a length and turning away outside off, cut to sweeper's right
tossed up outside off, driven down to long-off
good length and turning down leg, past the flick
googly, short of a length and into the hips. Dabbed to deep square
legbreak at a length outside off, bat comes down late on this defence. Thick inside edge to deep midwicket
length outside off, a legbreak. Stabbed to extra cover's left
googly spins in a long way as YJB leaves this. Short of a length and coming into the corridor. It was still a well-judged leave, but that will have made an impression in his mind
full at leg stump, leans in and tickles to short fine's left
slower ball, short of a length at middle stump. Check punch into the leg side and a loud call of no to send Bairstow back
slower ball, short of a length outside off. Slashed on the up to extra cover's right. Mayank gives chase
offcutter at a length, ripping into the body as he shapes to pull that
full toss down leg side, can't get bat on it
yorker length at leg stump, jammed into vacant midwicket and neither square leg nor deep midwicket go for it as they nearly run into each other
full offcutter just outside off, punched on the up to extra cover's left. A diving stop there
swatted over square leg. Treats him like a spinner and picks the spot with no deep fielders. Offcutter at a length on off stump, gets down on the floor and lifts it over the infield
short and just outside off, punched firmly off the back foot but straight to extra cover
slower ball, short and turning into off stump. Looks to pull and gets an inside edge onto pad
short of a length just outside off, punched into the covers off the back foot
just helps it over the long leg boundary. It's a slower ball, short one, rising up at hip height. Swivels and uses the angle to launch it. No one in the deep that side of the ground
full slower ball at off stump, jammed down the pitch off the front foot
full offcutter outside off, chopped out to sweeper cover
full at leg stump, flicked out to deep midwicket
ufff, sweet pull, but straight to deep midwicket. Slower short ball outside off, fetched firmly from there
good length and across the corridor, splits his leg and slices to sweeper's left. Slight fumble there allows them an easy second
offcutter at a length on off and middle, defended into the leg side off the inside edge, via front pad
short of a length slower ball just outside off, clears the front leg and looks to pump this straight, flat-batted. Can only slice it feebly to mid-off's right
slower ball at a length just outside off, cuts away from his attempted chop behind point
oh superb batting. Slower ball at a length just outside off, waits on that and cuts very very late to beat sweeper to the right
slower ball, short and climbing outside off. Beaten on the cut

Warner would've been run-out a second time! Short of a length at off stump, drops it to Allen's left at bakcward point. He's onto it quickly and Warner didn't even bother to try and make his ground. So far out, but Allen misses
low full toss at middle stump, half a stride across and gently pushed through vacant midwicket
full at middle stump, driven to mid-on's left
length outside off, looks to chop that on the rise and gets an under-edge to the keeper
launched over the long-on boundary. Tossed up, drifting into leg stump. Reaches the pitch of it lofts it with the full face offered
short of a length at off stump, hurriedly punched into the covers
length and sliding on outside off, punched to extra cover
beaten. Length ball outside off, pitches and turns away, also rises as he's beaten in flight and has a slash
short and sliding on just outside off, cut straight to short third
full and very wide again, this time YJB reaches out and carves that over the covers
tossed up full and very wide, left alone
full and just outside off, looks to drill that through cover but it ends up at mid-off, off the toe-end
length and just outside off. Walking a long way down the pitch as he turns this into the leg side off the inside edge, short fine can't stop the run
short of a length and just outside off, under-edge on the cut
slashed past point. Length ball, some width outside off. Stretches his arms and looks to drive. Not fully in control, but he's found the gap
full and at off stump, blocked on the front foot
good length and just outside off, defended on the front foot
